PRIVACY_CONTROLLER: The data controller is Isabella Laurenzi. For information: laurenzi.isabella@gmail.com.
PRIVACY_BODY: We only collect the data you voluntarily enter in the contact form (name, email, subject, message), which is forwarded by email to the controller. It is used solely to reply to your request, is not shared with third parties and is not used for marketing. For full details and to exercise your rights, please see the complete page.
PRIVACY_INTRODUCTION_TEXT: This website is the personal portfolio of Isabella Laurenzi (Isatis Illustration). This notice, provided under art. 13 of EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), describes which personal data are processed when you visit the website or use the contact form, for which purposes and with which safeguards. The website does not use profiling cookies, analytics or advertising tools.
PRIVACY_DATA_COLLECTED_DESCRIPTION: The contact form only collects the data you voluntarily enter:
PRIVACY_DATA_COLLECTED_ITEMS_EMAIL: Email address (required, to reply to you)
PRIVACY_DATA_COLLECTED_SENSITIVE: Please do not include special categories of data (for example about health, political or religious opinions) or other people's data in your message: they are not needed to answer your request.
PRIVACY_DATA_COLLECTED_TECHNICAL: While you browse the website, your browser also automatically sends some technical data to the providers hosting it (for example IP address, browser type, date and time of the request), which are needed to show you pages, images and fonts. These data are not used to identify or profile you.
PRIVACY_FORM_FLOW_TEXT: When you submit the form, your data pass through a small server of the website, which forwards them in an email sent from a dedicated service address (managed with Gmail) to the controller's personal mailbox. The website does not store messages in its own database: they are kept only in the mailboxes involved. You will receive the reply directly from the controller's email address.
PRIVACY_LEGAL_BASIS_TITLE: Purposes and Legal Basis of Processing
PRIVACY_LEGAL_BASIS_DESCRIPTION: Data are processed only for these purposes:
PRIVACY_LEGAL_BASIS_FORM: Replying to messages sent through the contact form (for example requests for information, quotes or collaborations): legal basis art. 6.1.b GDPR, i.e. steps taken at your request.
PRIVACY_LEGAL_BASIS_TECHNICAL: Running the website and protecting it from abuse (technical browsing data): legal basis art. 6.1.f GDPR, i.e. the controller's legitimate interest.
PRIVACY_LEGAL_BASIS_PROVISION: Providing your email and message is necessary to receive a reply; name and subject are optional. Data are not used for marketing, newsletters or profiling and are not subject to automated decision-making.
PRIVACY_RETENTION_DESCRIPTION: Emails received through the form are kept for as long as needed to handle the request and, unless required by law or by an ongoing collaboration, no longer than 12 months from the last contact, after which they are deleted. Technical browsing data are kept by the providers for the periods stated in their own privacy policies.
PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_TITLE: Providers and Recipients of the Data
PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_DESCRIPTION: Data are not sold or disclosed to third parties for commercial purposes. The following technical providers are used to run the website and process data only to deliver their service:
PRIVACY_PROVIDER_VERCEL: hosts the server that receives the contact form and provides the portfolio content.
PRIVACY_PROVIDER_GOOGLE: email service used to forward and receive the form messages; it also provides the website fonts (Google Fonts).
PRIVACY_PROVIDER_CLOUDINARY: stores and delivers the images of the artworks.
PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_NOTE_TEXT: These providers act as data processors under their own terms of service, pursuant to art. 28 GDPR
PRIVACY_TRANSFER_DESCRIPTION: Some of the providers listed above are based in the United States, so data may also be processed outside the European Union. These transfers rely on the European Commission's adequacy decision (EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework) or on the standard contractual clauses provided for by art. 46 GDPR.
PRIVACY_COOKIES_DESCRIPTION: The website does not use profiling, analytics or third-party advertising cookies. It only uses the browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your chosen language, the gallery filter and the last artwork you opened: this is technical information that stays on your device, is not sent to anyone and can be cleared at any time from your browser settings. No consent is required for this use.
PRIVACY_SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: The controller adopts appropriate measures to protect personal data, including:
PRIVACY_SECURITY_MEASURES_HTTPS: Encrypted HTTPS connection on every page and towards the form server
PRIVACY_SECURITY_MEASURES_CREDENTIALS: Service credentials kept on the server and never exposed on the website
PRIVACY_SECURITY_MEASURES_ACCESS: Access to the mailbox and services restricted to the controller
PRIVACY_RIGHTS_DESCRIPTION: As a data subject you can exercise at any time the rights provided for in articles 15-22 of the GDPR:
PRIVACY_RIGHTS_LIST_ACCESS: Right of access to personal data
PRIVACY_RIGHTS_LIST_RECTIFICATION: Right to rectification of inaccurate data
PRIVACY_RIGHTS_CONTACT: To exercise these rights, write to the controller at:
PRIVACY_COMPLAINT_DESCRIPTION: If you believe that the processing of your data infringes the GDPR, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali).
PRIVACY_COPYRIGHT_DESCRIPTION: All rights reserved. The illustrations, characters, drawings and other works published on this website are protected by copyright law (Italian Law 633/1941). Copying, downloading for reuse, modifying, distributing or using them for commercial purposes, or using them to train artificial intelligence systems, is not allowed without written permission.
PRIVACY_COPYRIGHT_CLIENTS: Works created for clients or in collaboration are shown for portfolio purposes; their rights may also belong to the respective clients and publishers.
